## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (EditorConfig)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (README, etc.)
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings (`dotnet build -c Release`)
- [ ] I have tested on TShock 6.1.0 / Terraria 1.4.5.6 / .NET 9.0
- [ ] I have added permissions to README if new commands added
- [ ] I have not committed any binary DLLs or sensitive data
- [ ] I have deregistered hooks and commands in Dispose()
